reading_method: Contiguous source reading including formal statements, examples, exercises, solutions and their summaries. Mechanical inventories are locators, not evidence of understanding.
acceptance: First use has a concrete referent and explicit scope.
Each retained technical construction supports a later argument, example, or contrast.
Examples teach why each step is taken and admit hand recomputation.
Summaries and exercise answers preserve theorem assumptions.
Open problems do not promise invented closed-form solutions.
Render converged Book and inspect changed spreads.
